patterns._comment: Feature pages are generated by ONE shared pagination template (src/features/feature-pages.njk -> src/_includes/feature-detail.njk) from src/_data/features.json — there is no per-slug file, so `file` is deliberately omitted here. Editing the shared .njk directly would change every feature page at once; per-slug content lives in features.json instead, hence the adapters below routing there. `title` maps to the dedicated `seoTitle` field (added specifically so the browser <title> can be auto-fixed independently of the visible `name` field, which also feeds breadcrumbs/cards). FAQ content lives at the nested `objections.items` path — `itemsParentField` narrows into the fixed `objections` object before splicing `items`, an addition to the platform's data-array-content adapter made for exactly this shape; q/a items are stored as {question, answer} to match the platform's own FAQ item convention.

Solution pages, same shared-template shape as features (src/solutions/solution-pages.njk -> src/_includes/solution-detail.njk, data from src/_data/solutions.json). solutions.json already has a top-level `faq` array per entry ({question, answer} shape), so it fits the data-array-content adapter directly with no itemsParentField needed. `title` maps to the dedicated `seoTitle` field, same reasoning as the features pattern above. `file` is omitted for the same shared-template reason as the features pattern.
